question:
Which of the following is the smallest ratio?

(5)/(6), (7)/(9), (11)/(12), (13)/(18)
solution:
**Calculations:**

5/6 = 0.8333

7/9 = 0.7778

11/12 = 0.9167

13/18 = 0.7222

⇒ The smallest decimal equivalent is for 13/18

**∴ The smallest ratio among the given options is __13/18__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** (5)/(6), (7)/(9), (11)/(12), (13)/(18) 

LCM of 6, 9, 12, and 18 = 36

Now the fraction becomes

5/6 = 30/36

7/9 = 28/36

11/12 = 33/36

13/18 = 26/36

Now, compare and find the smallest numerator

Smallest = 26/36 = 13/18

∴ The smallest ratio among the given options is __13/18__.
